label: Streaming AI Answer
description: An AI answer arriving the way it really does: the ask is typed into a composer, a beat of 'Thinking', then the answer streams in token bursts -- each word landing grey and settling to ink, a caret riding the tip. Full-frame type (default), or device 'phone': the keyboard rises for the ask, it sends as a bubble, the keyboard drops and the answer streams into the agent's bubble. Supports paragraphs, '- ' bullets and **bold** (brand color). Sized so the finished answer fits.

prompt.label: The ask, typed first (omit to start at the answer)

answer.label: The answer. New lines are paragraphs; '- ' starts a bullet; **bold** is set in the brand color

agent_name.label: Name beside the agent orb (default 'Quotient'; '' hides)

device.label: full (default: type on the scene) | phone

thinking.label: A 'Thinking' beat before the stream (default true)

words_per_second.label: Stream speed (default: the answer finishes by ~85% of the scene)

type_speed.label: Characters per second for the ask (default 24)

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene it starts (default 0.2)
